```python
import narwhals as nw
import pandas as pd

# Create sample data
df = nw.from_native(
    pd.DataFrame({
        "store": ["A", "B", "A", "B", "A"],
        "revenue": [100, 200, 150, 250, 120],
        "items": [5, 10, 7, 12, 6]
    })
)

# Group by store and compute statistics
result = df.group_by("store").agg(
    nw.col("revenue").sum(),
    nw.col("items").mean()
).sort("store")

print(result.to_native())
```
